qa_pairs.question: What component does the 1AZ reference refer to?
qa_pairs.answer: Idler lever to alternator bracket Replace screw

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual does this torque specification table belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: 11 - 20 Engine, specifically 11 28 V-ribbed belt with tension and deflection element

qa_pairs.question: Which screw has a higher torque specification - the alternator bracket screw or the bearing pin screw plug?
qa_pairs.answer: The alternator bracket screw has a higher torque specification at 90 Nm compared to the bearing pin screw plug at 20 Nm
